attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter, stated in his own voice.

semantics.note: Firm 'you are not recovering' with two necessary-condition exceptions, both kept. Context points to Amazon, Microsoft and Google. 'More' contracts is a fair reading of the call for new customers. No horizon was stated.

contract.note: Treating the exceptions as necessary rather than sufficient conditions, net recovery and no deadline are ordinary readings. The ambiguity flags are noted properly. The result turns on missing data, not on interpretation.

evidence.note: Microsoft's own disclosure of a $37B annualized AI revenue run rate. That is revenue, not cumulative net recovery of the investment, so it cannot settle recovery.

reviews.rationale: This is a firm forecast with no deadline. The packet's only item is a revenue run-rate disclosure, with no cost accounting for the investment cohort and no record of whether either exception has happened. No early-resolution event exists, so the evidence does not settle the claim.
